```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_flow.R")

PARADIGM    <- "active"
LOCK        <- "resp"
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261031"
CSD_LABEL   <- "CSD"
BC_LABEL    <- "bc-200-0"

DATA_ROOT      <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/flow/"
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/flow/castellar/"
DATE_STR       <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

n         <- length(INCLUDED_ACTIVE)
csv_fname <- glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_{PARADIGM}_{n}p_flow_resp_{BC_LABEL}_{CSD_LABEL}_castellar_p2p.csv")
csv_path  <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, csv_fname)

df_all <- read.csv(csv_path) %>%
  filter(participant %in% INCLUDED_ACTIVE) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))

cat("Loaded:", nrow(df_all), "rows |", n_distinct(df_all$participant), "participants\n")
cat("Configs:", paste(unique(df_all$channel_config), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(unique(df_all$condition), collapse=", "), "\n")
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: FLOW — Response-Locked (Castellar)  
**Paradigm**: ACTIVE  
**Lock**: Response  
**CSD**: {CSD_LABEL} | **Baseline**: {BC_LABEL}  
**Conditions**: {paste(CONDITION_LEVELS, collapse = ' vs ')}  
**N participants**: {n}  
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}  
"))
```

```{r analysis-functions}
run_ttest_block <- function(df, config_label, dv, dv_label, label_suffix) {
  cat(glue("\n### {dv_label}\n\n"))

  df_cond <- df %>%
    filter(channel_config == config_label) %>%
    select(participant, condition, value = all_of(dv)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))

  if (nrow(df_cond) == 0) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: No data for {config_label} {dv}\n\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  col_a <- paste0("value.", CONDITION_LEVELS[1])
  col_b <- paste0("value.", CONDITION_LEVELS[2])

  df_wide <- df_cond %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition,
                values_from = value, names_prefix = "value.",
                values_fn = mean) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("value."), as.numeric)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(c(col_a, col_b)))

  n_valid <- nrow(df_wide)
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

  # Boxplot
  df_long <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("value."), names_to = "condition",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(gsub("value\\.", "", condition),
                              levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))

  p <- df_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = value, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CONDITION_COLORS) +
    labs(title    = glue("{dv_label} — {config_label}"),
         subtitle = glue("N = {n_valid}"),
         x = NULL, y = dv_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  print(p)
  cat("\n")

  # Assumption check
  diffs   <- df_wide[[col_a]] - df_wide[[col_b]]
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(diffs)
  cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk**: W = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$statistic), 3)}, p = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$p.value), 3)}\n\n"))

  # T-test
  t_res  <- t.test(df_wide[[col_a]], df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  bf_res <- ttestBF(x = df_wide[[col_a]], y = df_wide[[col_b]], paired = TRUE)
  bf10   <- as.numeric(extractBF(bf_res)$bf)
  bf01   <- 1 / bf10

  df_long2 <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("value."), names_to = "condition", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(gsub("value\\.", "", condition), levels = CONDITION_LEVELS))
  d_res <- df_long2 %>% cohens_d(value ~ condition, paired = TRUE)

  means <- c(mean(df_wide[[col_a]], na.rm=TRUE), mean(df_wide[[col_b]], na.rm=TRUE))
  sds   <- c(sd(df_wide[[col_a]],  na.rm=TRUE), sd(df_wide[[col_b]],  na.rm=TRUE))

  apa <- apa_ttest(t_res, d_res, bf10, dv_label, config_label, "", "",
                   CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds)
  cat(glue("**APA:** {apa}\n\n"))

  list(
    summary = build_summary_row(dv_label, config_label, "", "",
                                CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds, t_res, d_res, bf10, bf01),
    apa     = apa
  )
}
```

## FCz — 0-300ms

```{r fcz-0-300, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

res <- run_ttest_block(df_all, "FCz_0-300", "p2p_amp_uv", "P2P Amplitude (uV/m2)", "FCz_0-300_amp")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["FCz_0-300_amp"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["FCz_0-300_amp"]] <- res$apa }

res <- run_ttest_block(df_all, "FCz_0-300", "p2p_lat_ms", "P2P Latency (ms)", "FCz_0-300_lat")
if (!is.null(res)) { summary_rows[["FCz_0-300_lat"]] <- res$summary; apa_texts[["FCz_0-300_lat"]] <- res$apa }
```
